comments.text:
Completed implementation of the ethereal theme:
- Added standalone static/themes/ethereal.css based on Antharchy/Omarchy ethereal color palette.
- Added "ethereal" to AVAILABLE_THEMES in markusmd.themes.
- Added [data-theme="ethereal"] styles to static/markus.css.
- Added BDD feature scenarios in features/themes.feature and updated features/site.feature.
- Verified with behave (all 135 scenarios passing), ruff lint, and demo site build.
